technology_name: COMPOSITION AND PREPARATION METHOD OF TUBULAR GRAPHITIC CARBON NITRIDE NANOTUBE USING EMILIA SONCHIFOLIA PAPPUS AS A BIO-TEMPLATE
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Conventional synthesis of graphitic carbon nitride nanotubes relies on hazardous, complex artificial templates that leave toxic chemical impurities and restrict environmental performance.
description: A sustainable chemical production method using the natural pappus of Emilia sonchifolia as a organic bio-template, which is treated with urea, ethanol, and nitric acid to synthesize pure tubular graphitic carbon nitride nanotubes via sonication.
applications: Environmental remediation catalysts, photocatalytic water splitting systems, industrial pollutant degradation arrays, and electrochemical sensor surfaces.
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Water, Environment & Waste Management
